services.desc: Date: November 1st, 2025Time: 11:00 am.Price: $10 QHS MembersLocation: In person at Kingsland Homestead, 143-35 37th Avenue On Saturday, November 1, John Juva, a childhood resident of Greenpoint Brooklyn will be conducting his second tour of his old neighborhood. The tour will include many buildings within the Greenpoint Landmark Historical District such as the site of four former movie theaters two churches numerous brownstone and historical houses and the remaining bulkhead of the former Vernon Avenue bridge to Queens. blurb: Built between 1774 and 1785, the Kingsland Homestead is one of the earliest surviving examples of residential style construction common throughout Long Island, specifically Queens, in the late 18th and 19th centuries. A Long Island half-house, it is characterized by a wide side hall and double parlors off to one side.
